column1: # name<TAB>setup<TAB>arguments[<TAB>refusal] (line RG items D5b-1 to D5b-5). Each row runs in a copy of in/: the setup steps
# (" ; "-separated: makembindex ARGS and makeblastdb ARGS with LOSAT's programs, put FILE OFFSET VALUE, cut FILE SIZE,
# cp FROM TO, rm FILE, cat OUT FROM... (the bytes of the FROM files), join OUT TITLE FROM... (one FASTA record ">TITLE" with
# the sequence lines of the FROM files); @TESTS@ in a step is LOSAT/tests), then blastn with the arguments (their first
# NAME=value words are variables of the run).
# ncbi/<name>.{out,err,rc}: NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (the official Linux x64 release, local oracle), 2026-11-21, with NCBI's makembindex
# and makeblastdb for the setup: the rows above "D5b-2 rows" by ad-RG-D5-4 with remaining-gaps-20261112/D/d5/fixture/freeze_d5b1.py,
# the rows down to "D5b-3 rows" by ad-RG-D5-5's subagent with freeze_d5b2.py there (which re-freezes every row; in/'s D5b-2 files:
# its --make-in-d5b2, gen2.py and gen_d5b2.py), the D5b-3 rows by ad-RG-D5-9 with freeze_d5b2.py --only, 2026-11-22 (in/qst1.fa
# and qst2.fa: two random queries each from that session's probe). Rows on databases made in the setup print no database date (outfmt 6).
# A row with a refusal is one where NCBI reads an index in an
# undefined way (or crashes): LOSAT refuses with "-use_index true with <refusal> is not supported by LOSAT's BLASTN", after the
# output of the query batches before; NCBI's output stays for the lines that take them. A fourth field "batch NAME" compares
# the row with row NAME's files: NCBI's search with the index of the same queries as one query batch (BATCH_SIZE=1000000000),
# a first search, at any -num_threads; LOSAT searches every query batch of an index of only some volumes with the index
# (the Owner's answer C to Q-MIXIDX, approved exception 30 of PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS; the D5c rows below).

# LOSAT's two-hit search, NCBI's search without the index with the rows of the index's pairs (blastn_mb_index_fixtures.rs,
# the_two_hit_index_search_adds_the_index_s_pairs), the same at 4 threads and on hmr. in/hm.fa, in/qhm.fa and the database hm
# (dustmasker's masks, algorithm 11): gen_d5b5.py; in/hmr.fa and the database hmr (hm's letters with every masked one replaced
# at random, hm's masks): gen_d5b5_r.py; both by NCBI's programs.
# D5c rows (2026-11-24, ad-RG-D5-13): an index of only some volumes searched in several query batches or query chunks, every
# one with the index's seeds (the Owner's answer C to Q-MIXIDX, approved exception 30 of PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS). NCBI's own
# search with the index of such a row loses the seeds of the last index volume before a volume without one after its first

# NAME_1b: the search as one query batch (a first search, which loses none); rows NAME_n: the search without the index (one-hit
